title: LOGOS ASF — TR-06C Live Evaluation Case
description: Contract for one future live behavioral evaluation case against a registered Abigail candidate. Defines the prompt, expected and forbidden behaviors, and rubric. Execution is constitutionally disabled in TR-06C: requires_live_inference=true but execution_allowed=false. No inference is performed here.

live_eval_case_id.description: Deterministic ID. Format: LC-<sha256[:16]>. Stable for same candidate/category/prompt.

case_category.description: Which TR-06A gate this live eval case targets. Mirrors evaluation_gate enum.

candidate_artifact_id.description: The MA-* artifact from the TR-05 model registry that this case targets.

input_prompt.description: The prompt to be sent to the candidate in a future live eval execution. Eval data only — not training data.

expected_behavior.description: Natural-language description of what the candidate should do. Used by human reviewers and future automated rubric checkers.

forbidden_behavior.description: Natural-language description of what the candidate must not do. Any occurrence of forbidden behavior → block result.

rubric.description: Structured scoring criteria. pass_criteria, fail_criteria, and block_criteria are required.

requires_live_inference.description: Always true for TR-06C cases. These cases require the candidate to be invoked.

execution_allowed.description: Always false in TR-06C. Execution is constitutionally disabled until an operator-approved executor is enabled.

operator_approval_required.description: Always true. Operator must approve execution before any live eval runs.

promotion_blocked.description: Always true. No live eval case can emit a promotion decision.

promotion_decision_emitted.description: Always false. TR-06C never emits a promotion decision.

metadata_prerequisites.description: List of TR-06A/B metadata evaluation gate names or report IDs that must pass before this live eval case can be scheduled.

notes.description: Free-text notes about this case's purpose and scope.

x-invariants.execution_disabled_const: execution_allowed is const:false. TR-06C cases cannot be executed without an operator-approved executor.
x-invariants.requires_live_inference_const: requires_live_inference is const:true. These cases are defined precisely because they require live inference — they cannot be evaluated from metadata alone.
x-invariants.promotion_blocked_const: promotion_blocked is const:true. No live eval case can promote, unblock, or modify promotion_status.
x-invariants.promotion_decision_never_emitted: promotion_decision_emitted is const:false. No promotion pathway is created by a TR-06C case.
x-invariants.input_prompt_is_eval_data: input_prompt holds evaluation prompt text. It is NOT training data and must not enter the training corpus.
x-invariants.no_provider_calls: No provider SDK calls occur in TR-06C. The executor is disabled.
x-invariants.no_model_weights: No model weights are loaded, referenced by path, or created in TR-06C.
x-invariants.no_tr07: TR-07 shadow/canary was not started here.
x-invariants.no_training: No real training occurs in TR-06C.
x-invariants.no_store1: No Store 1 writes occur in TR-06C.
